name: BN5's panel restore timers
why: BN5's panel update writes a plain panel's two restore timers every frame, 0x3C0 at +0x10 and +0x14, bytes BN6's panel has no place for (BN6 keeps one timer, at its +0x12). Exact: those bytes, that value. The family's code reads and writes no panel (its own routines touch only its object, its AI's data and its attack's variables; the reticle reaches the panels only through the engine's collision routines).
evidence: BN5's update of a plain panel: 0x0800A9DE-0x0800A9E8 writes 0x258 to +0x0E, 0x3C0 to +0x10 and +0x14
